'''Treema''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], and the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] only [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> In [[44 ABY]], it was visited by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], and [[Vestara Khai]].
